name: Karnwasten
summary: Karnwasten is a public dungeon found on the northern coast of Summerset. This cove is the main base of operations of the Night Runner smugglers, although their activities have recently been disturbed by a powerful Sea Sload moving in and causing havoc. The book Summerset Isles: A Visitor's Guide can be found shortly after you've entered. Its bosses have a chance to drop the Nautilus Shell Guards antiquity lead for the Thrassian Stranglers. The seven fragments for the Big-eared Ginger Kitten pet and achievement are randomly dropped from enemies in this zone.
notes: This location previously appeared in Arena as Karnwasten Moor.
Unlike King's Haven Pass, a similar location which has two entrances at two different locations across the island, only the northwest entrance of Karnwasten has an icon on the map.
